prayerJournal.example: Hifadhi hitaji hili katika shajara yako ya maombi.
prayerJournal.note: Kichupo kwa sasa kinaitwa “Jarida”; mhakiki asilia athibitishe.

thanksgiving.note: Hatua ya kumshukuru Mungu katika maombi.

renunciation.example: Katika maombi ya kukataa unataja kile unachokiacha.
renunciation.note: Msamiati wa huduma ya ukombozi. Unahitaji mhakiki asilia.

sanctification.example: Utakaso ni kazi ya Mungu ndani yetu.
sanctification.note: God's work of making believers holy over time; never self-improvement or self-optimisation.

calling.example: Omba kuhusu wito wa Mungu maishani mwako.
calling.note: God's call on a life; not career branding or 'purpose' coaching.

surrender.example: Kujisalimisha kwa Mungu ni kumwamini, si kukata tamaa.
surrender.note: Entrusting oneself and one's desires to God's will (Gethsemane); not resignation, defeat or passivity.

abidingInChrist.example: Kaa ndani ya Kristo kama tawi katika mzabibu.
abidingInChrist.note: John 15: remaining joined to Christ in trust and obedience, as a branch to the vine.

worship.note: Honouring God for who He is; praise is one expression of worship.

confession.example: Kuungama dhambi kunafungua njia ya msamaha.
confession.note: Telling God the truth about sin (1 John 1:9); distinct from a confession of faith.

forgiveness.note: God's forgiveness of sin, and forgiving others; forgiving never requires returning to danger.

prayer.note: Speaking with God; never a meditation technique or positive thinking. Wakristo wa Kiprotestanti husema "maombi"; "sala" ni ya kiliturujia zaidi.
